title: Concept: Package entry accepting a pre-release band
description: packages.config declares an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
